name: escrcpy
description_en: 📱 Display and control your Android device graphically with scrcpy.
readme_excerpt: Escrcpy 📱 Display and control your Android device graphically with scrcpy. 中文文档 Escrcpy focuses on a stable integration foundation; some advanced features come from the private extension repository EscrcpyX and are offered on a paid basis. Features - 🖥️ Inset Mirror: Dedicated embedded window, auto-fits screen resolution and orientation, with integrated one-tap shortcuts - ⌨️ Keyboard Mapping: Configure touch, joystick, swipe, scroll, and automation mappings directly on the embedded mirror -…
